raw_blocks: As a global leader in fashion, we unlock the value of our 30+ brands through our team’s agility and innovation.
We are global experts in design, sourcing, distribution and marketing, bringing excitement and confidence to customers through the fashion we create.
Brands Across a Range of Categories
With over 30 owned and licensed global brands in our portfolio, our strengths across the full product life cycle enable us to unlock their value and fuel growth.

Marc Jacobs is an iconic American fashion house known for its fearless designs and playful approach to luxury. Since its inception in 1984, the brand has created a lasting impact on the fashion industry, becoming synonymous with creativity, individuality, and timeless craftsmanship. Marc Jacobs continues to influence the world of fashion with its innovative vision and bold approach to style.

When Donna Karan launched her first collection in 1984, she started with a city, Seven Easy Pieces, and the power of a woman—and she revolutionized the way women dress. Acquired by G-III in 2016, Donna Karan has been reimagined for a new era of modern women.

Founded in 1984, the House of Karl Lagerfeld shares the iconic vision and design aesthetic of its namesake, fused with a contemporary, forward-looking spirit. Acquired by G-III in May 2022, the brand is entering a phase of global growth.
From the house founded by Donna Karan in 1984, DKNY emerged in 1989. Acquired by G-III in December 2016, the brand continues to be recognized as one of the most heralded names in American fashion.

Vilebrequin cultivates a spirit of refinement and fantasy, staying true to the casual charm the house was founded on in St. Tropez in 1971. Vilebrequin joined the G-III portfolio in 2012, providing the company with a new core competency and a robust global retail network.

G-III’s success comes from our agility, drive and dedication to delivering for our customers. Every member of the team brings a unique point of view that adds something special to our company and the products we create.
